evidence.statement: The combined Premier Triage and Response aggregate lists Cloud Platform 10.2.x+ and ES 8.6+ with paired SOAR and representative enablement; task prerequisites state ES 8.7+ and assistant/permissions/existing-findings requirements. The 8.7 task is historical. CMP requires Platform 10.4+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0+, with SAIA 2.4+ confirmed in the indexed exact setup section. Current 2.3.6 Cloud Connected restrictions and planned 2.4.0 prevent treating the path as usable. November 4 ES 8.8 GA and product region tables do not establish pairing, per-agent rollout, entitlement or authorization.
